decisions.reason: As a multi-model lever-handle family in the firm's core business, it still supports portfolio breadth for different specifications, though after four years some pruning risk is higher than at launch.
A single door-handle design is easier to rationalize once it is no longer new, but it remains close to the firm's design-led core offer and is therefore more likely to be kept than dropped.
This design variant still fits the established hardware range, yet standalone designs face a meaningful risk of replacement or consolidation as the firm refreshes its assortment.
A handle family with several models continues to strengthen the firm's broad specification offering, so a large German supplier would usually retain it unless range simplification becomes necessary.
The electronic access system matches the firm's strategic move toward integrated digital building solutions, so despite normal lifecycle and update risk it remains unlikely to be withdrawn outright.
